items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: This boy Burnell, he's one of the best. And that boy could wake his finger like an electric piano.

ctx.x: Well, who were the piano players? Do you remember any of them?

Well, yes. I remember a wood of them. We had some wonderful piano players. That's some of these, well, in these late years, right around here, youngsters. This boy Burnell, he's one of the best. And that boy could wake his finger like an electric piano. The dope killed him. We got another man called Little Willie. The dope killed him. See, one of the things about them, and see, if they were using the right stuff, but they would get that junk. And that junk just knocks them out. Where's Red Caillou, he was a…
Back to these piano players, do you remember Gang Kid?
